classes.name: NoData / Masked
classes.description: Unclassified, masked furniture, neatlines, roads, or invalid pixels

classes.name: Alluvial Soil
classes.description: High-fertility transported sediment composed of loam, silt, and fine clay along river basins

classes.name: Black Soil (Vertisol)
classes.description: Deep black montmorillonite clay soils with high water retention and self-mulching swelling/shrinkage properties

classes.name: Red Soil
classes.description: Porous, friable soil rich in ferric oxides developed over crystalline granite and metamorphic rocks

classes.name: Lateritic Soil
classes.description: Hardened residual tropical soil formed by intensive leaching of silica, rich in hydrated iron and aluminum oxides

classes.name: Sandy / Desert Soil
classes.description: Coarse, unaggregated quartz sand with minimal organic matter and high evaporation rates
